_comment: CANONICAL OID4VP-DCQL conformance vectors. Generated by the reference evaluator, which refuses to emit a row it disagrees with; this copy is the reference test/oid4vp.conformance.ts runs the TypeScript port against. Refreshing it is a manual step. ⚠ These are self-generated and prove the two implementations agree with EACH OTHER, not with the specification — import external OID4VP conformance vectors when obtainable.

evaluation.name: pinned issuer: wrong issuer is denied
open issuer form: self-issued did:key counts
nested issuer path does not count
one of several presented credentials matches
number claim matches a JSON number
empty values can never be satisfied
oauth: a holder without the permission is denied
oauth: another relying party's audience is denied
oauth: a holder without the realm role is denied
oauth: a wallet credential does not satisfy an oauth rule
max_age_secs on a credential format is refused
identity-scoped rule refused by plain evaluate

scope_matcher.name: exact grant does not cover a child
exact grant does not cover a different leaf
prefix grant covers the base itself
prefix grant covers a deep descendant
NUL-bearing identity is covered by nothing
oversize identity is covered by nothing

identity_scoped.name: same grant from the namespace owner is authorized
non-string issuer claim fails the namespace binding
any namespace + pinned issuer grants across namespaces
any namespace + open issuer refused at validation
scope claim without a matching claims entry
unscoped rule cannot authorize a scoped operation
unsatisfied WHO gate: a scope grant is never consulted
worked use case: licensure + consent, in scope
worked use case: another patient's consent does not cross

commitment.name: same rule, keys reordered — must equal baseline
same rule, whitespace — must equal baseline
same rule, \u escaping — must equal baseline
numeric claim value — the shape that panicked
numeric 3.0 — must equal the integer form
